plays.name: Horns Elbow Entry
plays.summary: Bigs at both elbows, shooters in the corners. Enter to the elbow, then flow into a hand-off and a downhill drive.

roles.1: Make the entry pass on time, then space out to the right wing.
roles.2: Stay in the corner until 1 passes. Lift to the wing and come hard off the hand-off.
roles.3: Stay wide in the right corner and be ready for the kick-out.
roles.4: Catch, face up and look for 5 first. Then dribble into the hand-off and roll.
roles.5: Roll hard to the rim after the entry. Clear to the short corner when 2 drives.

steps.note: 1 passes to 4 at the left elbow. 5 rolls hard to the rim.
1 cuts away to the right wing. 2 lifts from the corner to the left wing.
4 dribbles at 2 and hands it off. 2 takes it toward the middle.
2 attacks the lane. 4 seals and rolls to the block. 5 clears to the short corner.

plays.name: Spread Pick and Roll
plays.summary: Four out, one in. A high ball screen with room for the roller and shooters spotted up.

roles.1: Wait for the screen. Come off it tight, shoulder to hip, and read the roller.
roles.2: Lift to the top as the safety when 1 comes off the screen.
roles.3: Stay in the right corner. If your defender helps on the roll, you're open.
roles.4: Stay in the left corner and keep your defender far from the paint.
roles.5: Sprint up, set a solid screen on the right side of 1's defender, then roll to the rim.

steps.note: 5 sprints up and sets a ball screen on the right side of 1's defender.
1 uses the screen going right. 5 rolls to the rim. 2 lifts to the top as the safety.
1 hits 5 on the roll for a layup. If the roll is covered, kick to 3 in the corner.

plays.name: Box Back Screen
plays.summary: Baseline out of bounds from a box set. A decoy cut clears the left side, then a back screen frees 1 at the rim.

roles.1: Wait for 4 to screen, then cut off the screen straight to the front of the rim.
roles.2: Sprint to the left corner. Your cut pulls a defender away.
roles.3: Slap the ball to start it. Look for 1 first, then 5 at the elbow.
roles.4: Step up and back-screen 1's defender. Hold it until 1 is past you.
roles.5: Pop to the left elbow as the safety outlet.

steps.note: 2 cuts hard to the left corner as a decoy. 4 steps up and back-screens for 1.
1 cuts off the screen to the front of the rim. 5 pops to the left elbow as the safety.
3 passes to 1 for the layup. If it's covered, throw to 5 at the elbow.

plays.name: 2-3 Zone Slides
plays.summary: Where each defender goes as the ball moves from the top, to the wing, to the corner and on a skip pass.

roles.X1: Top left. You drop to the high post when the ball goes right and close out when it comes back to your side.
roles.X2: Top right. Close out on the right wing. When the ball goes to the corner, drop to the elbow.
roles.X3: Back left. Slide to the middle of the lane when the ball is on the right side.
roles.X4: Back right. Slide out to the corner and close out when the ball gets there.
roles.X5: Middle. Always be on the ball side of the block. Front the post when the ball is in the corner.

steps.note: Ball to the right wing. X2 closes out on the ball. X1 drops to the high post. X4 slides toward the corner, X5 to the ball-side block, X3 to the middle of the lane.
Ball to the corner. X4 closes out. X5 fronts the block. X2 drops to the elbow, X1 takes the high post, X3 protects the rim.
Skip pass to the left wing. Everyone sprints: X1 closes out, X3 gets back to the left block, X5 to the middle, X4 to the right block, X2 to the high post.

plays.name: Ball Screen Hedge
plays.summary: How we guard a high ball screen: talk early, hedge to stop the ball, tag the roller, then recover.

roles.X1: Hear the call, then fight over the top of the screen. Recover to the ball fast.
roles.X2: Stay in the gap between your player and the ball.
roles.X3: Stay home in the corner. Don't leave a shooter.
roles.X4: You're the low helper. Tag the roller, then get back to the corner.
roles.X5: Call 'Screen right!' early. Jump out to stop the ball, then sprint back to the roller.

steps.note: 5 comes up to set the ball screen. X5 calls "Screen right!" and follows one step behind.
1 turns the corner. X5 jumps out to stop the ball (hedge). X1 fights over the top. X4 leaves the corner to tag the roller.
X1 recovers to the ball. X5 sprints back to the roller. X4 returns to the corner.

plays.name: 1-2-2 Matchup Zone
plays.summary: Draft from standard rules. Check it against how we play it. Looks like a 1-2-2 zone, but every defender matches up on a player in their area. Pressure the ball up top, keep the middle closed, and talk on every pass.

roles.X1: Point. Pressure the ball at the top and turn it to a side. When it goes to a wing, drop to the ball-side elbow to close the middle.
roles.X2: Left wing. Take the player on the left wing. When the ball is on the other side, sink to the middle of the lane for help.
roles.X3: Right wing. Take the player on the right wing. When the ball goes to the corner, drop to take away the pass back and the high post.
roles.X4: Left back. Take anyone in the left corner or on the left block. When the ball is on the other side, you protect the rim.
roles.X5: Right back. Guard the post on the high side when the ball is above you. Close out when the ball goes to your corner.

steps.note: 1 passes to the right wing. X3 closes out on 2 under control. X1 drops to the ball-side elbow to close the middle. X5 plays 5 on the high side. X2 sinks to the middle of the lane and X4 sags toward the lane.

5 pops to the right corner and 2 passes there. X5 follows and closes out. X3 drops to take away the pass back and the elbow. X1 helps on the high post. X4 rotates to the rim and X2 splits the weak side.
Skip pass to the left wing. Everyone sprints to a new matchup: X2 closes out on 3, X4 gets back to 4 in the corner, X1 closes the middle, and X3 and X5 sink to weak-side help.

plays.name: 1-3-1 Matchup Zone
plays.summary: Draft from standard rules. Check it against how we play it. A 1-3-1 shell that matches up on the players in each area. The back defender covers both corners, and the middle defender stays between the ball and the high post.

roles.X1: Point. Pressure the ball and keep it out of the middle. Drop into the gap to help when the ball goes to the other guard.
roles.X2: Left wing. Take anyone on the left wing. On a skip to the left corner, close out until X5 gets there, then go back up.
roles.X3: Right wing. Take anyone on the right wing. When the ball goes to the corner, drop to take away the pass back and the block.
roles.X4: Middle. Stay between the ball and the high post at all times. Drop to the block when the ball goes to the corner.
roles.X5: Back. You cover both corners and the low post. Sprint corner to corner, and get to the high side of the post when the ball is on the wing.

steps.note: 1 passes to 2 on the right side. X3 jumps out to pressure the ball. X1 drops into the gap to help. X4 slides to stay between the ball and 4. X5 gets to the high side of 5. X2 sinks into the lane.
5 pops to the right corner and catches the pass. X5 takes the corner. X3 drops to take away the pass back. X4 drops to the ball-side block, X2 protects the rim and X1 covers the high post.

Skip pass to 3 in the left corner. X2 closes out until X5 can get there. X5 sprints across the baseline. X4 slides to the middle, X3 sinks to weak-side help and X1 takes the left wing to stop the reversal.
